title: Problem with xDrip
body:
Hello, I just bought a mi band 5 to link up with my fresstyle libre 2. I installed the apk Libre 2 patched. I installed xDrip but when it asks "What type of Libre Bridge device do you use?", it doesn't appear the opcion "Libre2 patched".
What could I do?

Thanks

comments.body: I downloaded the last version I found, here you have a photo

There is no photo attached. Please do not add fotos. Instead, write the version number here.

You should install the latest version from the [releases page](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases).
Sorry; i don't know why the photo is not attached. Here you have the one I downloaded: xDrip-plus-20201127-b978bec.apk
That's the newest version. Indeed, there is "Libre2 (patched App)" listed in the Settings > Hardware Data Source.
Thanks!, I could do it the way you say. Now I don't know the next step to link xDrip with the mi band 5..

Sorry, this is not a support forum. Please search the existing issues and ask for help in the Facebook group [xDripG5](https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5) or the Gitter room [xDrip-plus](https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus).
Ok, thank you for your help anyway
